label: L A M P L I G H T   S C R I P T U R E
end_line: The whole story of Daniel is waiting for you. The link is in the description. Subscribe, and tap the bell, for more Bible stories for sleep.
text: A decree was signed: for thirty days, no one may ask anything of any god or any man, except the king. An old man heard the news, and went home. When Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house, now his windows were open in his room toward Jerusalem, and he kneeled on his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did before. Before long, he was sent down into the den of lions.
